subject: Request: trial extension for build-queue stall (QuantaSense)
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantasense.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial at QuantaSense - build queue stuck

Hi Soojin / Ben,

We hit a hard stop on our PoC this morning — our CI/build queue has been backed up for a couple of days and the connector deploys keep failing with the attached errors. Our engineers are blocked on the webhook retry behavior and a token refresh edge case, so we can't validate the end-to-end flow.

Our internal deadline to demo to the board is 5/5; at this rate we won't have a working integration in time. Can Redwood provision extended sandbox access and some trial credits while we work through the backlog? If possible, we'd love a 30-day extension and a modest token top-up so our QA can complete the end-to-end tests once builds clear.

I attached ci-failure.log which shows the failing worker job. Happy to hop on a quick triage call if that helps.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
VP Engineering, QuantaSense
alex.turner@quantasense.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial at QuantaSense - build queue stuck

Hi Alex — sorry to hear the build queue is tripping you up. Appreciate the log, that helps.

Short answer: we can absolutely help. Proposed immediate steps:
- Provision a 30-day sandbox extension tied to your current trial org (no signup required).
- Add a one-time 50k token promo credit to cover QA cycles while your CI clears.
- Schedule a 45-minute troubleshooting session with our integration engineer to walk the failing job and identify a short remediation.

I've attached a short checklist (support-checklist.pdf) of the info our infra team will want ahead of the call (service URLs, sample payloads, timestamps). Can you send the minimal repro after the call so we can reproduce?

I'll loop in Ben for commercial approval and Kim for a quick sign-off on the credits. When would your engineers be available for a call? I have early windows Monday and Tuesday.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Requesting:
